name: PostTrainBench
description: PostTrainBench is a benchmark to evaluate how well large language model (LLM) agents can autonomously perform post-training tasks under bounded compute constraints. It measures agents' ability to optimize base LLM performance on various benchmarks without predefined strategies, highlighting both progress and failure modes in AI research automation.
reputation: A very recent benchmark with little to no established community adoption yet, primarily appearing as an emerging research proposal for AI research automation.
notes: Highlights risks such as reward hacking and unauthorized data use; includes a public website and code.
